verdict.rationale: Shortcut documents a first-party Automations feature that removes repetitive steps: it auto-starts and auto-completes Epics, auto-creates future Iterations, and moves unfinished Stories to the next Iteration. These are fixed, predefined automations, not a user-configurable trigger-and-action rule builder. The REST API is only a developer building block for custom automation, so it earns no credit here. Missing for 10: a user-built custom trigger/condition/action rule builder, documentation of configurable triggers and actions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can build trigger-and-action automation rules to eliminate repetitive manual steps

citations.quote: Automations Auto-start and auto-complete an Epic, auto-create future Iterations, and move unfinished Stories to the next Iteration
